messages:
Kai: hypothetical fire question for the team: if the company catered one snack forever, forever-ever, what is it? short answers only :)
Rina: Homemade soft pretzels. Pull-apart sharing energy. :pretzel:
Omar: Sea-salted kettle chips. Crunch levels unmatched. :chip: :ok_hand:
Bea: Mini churros. Cinnamon dusting = morale boost. :cinnamon_roll:
Vik: Edamame bowls. Healthy flex and quiet shell-cracking. :seedling:
snack-bot: Poll created  react with :one: pretzels, :two: chips, :three: churros, :four: edamame
Kai: Also include one wildcard: if none of the above, reply with emoji + one word.
Rina: :one: but only if warm with mustard.
Omar: :two: because meetings need crunch therapy.
Bea: :three: imagine conference rooms smelling amazing.
Vik: :four: low sugar, high productivity.
Rina: wildcard: :cookie: biscotti (one-word: dunkable)
Omar: wildcard: :banana: plantain (one-word: nostalgic)
Bea: wildcard: :popcorn: caramelized (one-word: cinematic)
Kai: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/food-delicious-snack-3o6ZsYKt6bWZQ2g1Ic "snack decisions"
Vik: Friendly reminder: votes count but snacks are ultimately chosen by budget committee (read: the person who orders). :money_with_wings:
Kai: Poll ends EOD. Winner earns a tiny decorative plaque in the kitchen: "Snack To Rule Them All" :trophy:
Rina: If pretzels win I will personally bring dipping sauces weekly. Deal. :handshake:
Omar: If chips win I will compose a Haiku about crunch.
Bea: If churros win someone better bring hot chocolate.
Vik: If edamame wins I will tolerate one less donut Monday each month. :grin:
